company.shortDescription: MyBenefits is a SaaS system and app that provides companies access to thousands of discounts across all markets and tracks access and usage
company.description:
MyBenefits offers corporates a flexible and scalable solution to standardize staff discounts, flexible benefits and wellness initiatives throughout all markets. HR teams and managers are able to manage access, distribute rewards, monitor usage, and customize what content is displayed through an easy to use admin tool. With a simple request MyBenefits can turn on hundreds of staff discounts in any market, anywhere.

Employees have access to an app based on their work ID and able to use exclusive discounts, offers and access events specifically because they work for an organization.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,520,527 to $8,154,287, a 1.48x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 68 (+32 over 90 days) and market heat at 61 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include PerkSpot, BenefitHub, Access Perks.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
